ESSENCE.Sheet.UsedThisAdventureHint: Used allocation stays committed for the rest of the Adventure, even if stored, lent, depleted, lost, or replaced. Only Unused items freely transfer to an equal-capacity replacement on Armory access.
ESSENCE.Sheet.ToggleItemUsedAria: Mark {name} as used or unused this Adventure
ESSENCE.Common.Label: Label
ESSENCE.Common.Name: Name
ESSENCE.Sheet.TokenImageTooltip: Token Image — the art shown on the canvas. Separate from the Portrait above; see the Game Master's Guide for how the two relate.
ESSENCE.Sheet.UnlockedTooltip: Sheet unlocked — click to lock Attributes/Styles/build fields again
ESSENCE.Sheet.LockedTooltip: Sheet locked — click to edit Attributes/Styles/build fields
ESSENCE.Sheet.OpenSpeciesHint: open Species — e.g. to choose Species Traits
ESSENCE.Sheet.MonsterDistinctionHint: optional — only needed to unlock a gated Combat Style (Gestalt, Magecraft, Psionics, Ritualism, Calling)
ESSENCE.Sheet.AdaptabilityRerollHint: Restored automatically by Recovery — does not stack with an unused use.
ESSENCE.Sheet.InfluenceRecoveryNote: Core Influence does not clear through ordinary Recovery — each Influence Consequence Card attached below states what actually repairs that consequence. Essence has no universal day/week/month schedule.
ESSENCE.Sheet.ReachHint: The scale across which wealth, reputation, and connections remain meaningful — gates what Availability/Tier of Inventory Equipment this NPC can carry (see Equipment section below).
ESSENCE.Sheet.ReachPressureNote: Reach pressure recorded: {n} / {max} — Reach itself never decreases; resets at an Adventure boundary.
ESSENCE.Sheet.ExceptionalLoad: Exceptional load: {lb} lb — in addition to normal personal equipment; no Armory/Inventory capacity change.
ESSENCE.Sheet.RunningJump: Running jump: {units} units — needs a 2-unit run-up; uses normal Movement, grants none extra.
ESSENCE.Sheet.ExtremeExertion: Extreme exertion: {minutes} minutes ({rounds} Rounds) before the hazard procedure applies.
ESSENCE.Sheet.SustainedAttention: Sustained attention: {hours} hours of demanding watch/study before a strain roll.
ESSENCE.Sheet.ExtendedSenses: Extended Senses: +{bonus} unit(s) to a finite-range specialty Sense's detection range, or {range} units of precise natural vision if you have no eligible Sense (alternative benefits — apply whichever fits this character).
ESSENCE.Sheet.ResetAdventureUsesTooltip: Also resets accumulated Reach pressure, every owned Function Augment's Uses, and every Consumable Kit's Equipment Card Uses
ESSENCE.Sheet.NewEncounterTooltip: Resets once-per-Encounter Combat/Reaction Card cooldowns. Starting a new Combat inside the same Encounter does NOT do this automatically — use this button explicitly.
ESSENCE.Sheet.PresenceGrantTooltip: Once per Adventure, gain Temporary Influence equal to your Presence. Tracked separately from ordinary Temporary Influence; any unspent portion expires when the Adventure ends. Does not increase Reach, Armory, or Inventory limits.
ESSENCE.Sheet.NoBasicActions: No Basic Actions — drag Hide, Strike, etc. from the compendium.
ESSENCE.Sheet.NoActionCards: No Action Cards — drag one from the compendium.
ESSENCE.Sheet.NoBasicReactions: No Basic Reactions — drag Brace, etc. from the compendium.
ESSENCE.Sheet.NoReactionCards: No Reaction Cards — drag one from the compendium.
ESSENCE.Sheet.EquipmentCardsHint: (granted by Inventory Equipment — does not count against Card Count)
ESSENCE.Sheet.OverInventoryLimitPlural: Over your Inventory Limit by {n} slots (rounded up) — pay 1 ordinary Influence pressure per extra slot to cover it. Another character may pay it instead.
ESSENCE.Sheet.OverInventoryLimitSingular: Over your Inventory Limit by {n} slot (rounded up) — pay 1 ordinary Influence pressure per extra slot to cover it. Another character may pay it instead.
ESSENCE.Sheet.ExceedsReachException: Exceeds Reach even with the {source} exception's allowed margin.
ESSENCE.Sheet.ExceedsReachNpc: Reach cost exceeds this NPC's current Reach. Non-blocking.
ESSENCE.Npc.MonsterCreatorTooltip: Auto-generate or hand-build a stat block
ESSENCE.Character.ComboTooltip: Whenever you inflict Damage with a Prowess Action/Reaction, gain 1 Combo (max 5). Each Combo adds 1 Movement. Lose 1 if you dealt no Damage this Turn, or whenever you suffer a non-Temporary Wound.
ESSENCE.Character.LockTooltip: Burn 1 die when using a Ballistics Action against a target in your line of sight to establish Lock on it. Only one Lock at a time; lost if the target leaves your line of sight through the end of your Turn.
ESSENCE.Character.AdaptationTooltip: A Gestalt card's Rider may offer an Adaptation. You may maintain only one; pay its Stamina upkeep at the end of your Turn or it ends.
ESSENCE.Character.ContingencyTooltip: A Cunning card's Rider may establish a Contingency (a Trigger and an effect). Only one per Round; resolve it when the Trigger occurs. Expires at the start of your next Turn if unused.
ESSENCE.Character.ThreadsTooltip: Every Magecraft Action creates the fixed Thread of its subtype. Maintain up to 3; consume them for later Magecraft effects. Unused Threads end when the Encounter ends.
ESSENCE.Character.StrainTooltip: Capped at 6. 0-2: no penalty. 3-4: -1 Composure. 5-6: -1 Composure and Psionics cards require 1 additional burned die. Harmony and Fortitude are never affected by Strain. Removed only by effects that specifically remove it, Recovery, or Downtime (clears it).
ESSENCE.Character.StrainBurnSurcharge: Strain 5-6: Psionics cards require 1 additional burned die.
ESSENCE.Character.AuthorityTooltip: After a Leadership Action, store one rolled result as Authority (max: half Leadership Rank, rounded up). Spend it in place of a die you'd roll/burn, or for a card's Authority effect. Ends when the Encounter ends.
ESSENCE.Character.RitesTooltip: A Ritualism card's Rider establishes a Rite (Trigger, Echo, Echo Limit). Maintain up to 3. When the Trigger occurs, resolve the Echo and reduce the Rite's remaining Echoes by 1; remove it after its final Echo.
ESSENCE.Character.ManifestationTooltip: Use the mask icon in this sheet's header menu to fully manifest — it swaps your token to a persistent NPC Actor from the Calling Full Manifestations compendium with its own combat profile and Wound Track. If that form is defeated, its subtype becomes Broken until Downtime.
ESSENCE.Character.NotManifested: Not manifested — use this sheet's header menu to enter.
ESSENCE.Character.ManifestationDialogHin: Pay this Calling card's Rider by hand first — burn 3 Action Dice (2 with the Summoner Origin) plus Mana equal to the card's Rank + 1 — then confirm below to swap your token to that profile's own NPC sheet for the rest of the Encounter.
ESSENCE.Manifestation.OverflowNote: {n} Wound(s) have overflowed this track — these transfer to the caller when Apply Manifestation Defeat is used.
ESSENCE.Character.AdvancementPointsToolt: Advancement Points earned beyond standard Character Creation: (Tier-1) x 10 + (Level-1), max 49. Read-only — the Skill Tree that spends these hasn't been built yet.
ESSENCE.Character.ReachHint: The scale across which your wealth, reputation, and connections remain meaningful — gates what Availability/Tier of Inventory Equipment you can carry (see Equipment tab). Manually GM-awarded, not a computed formula.
ESSENCE.Character.ReachTriggerExamples: (Letters of Standing, Fence's Cache, Prepared Cache, ...)
ESSENCE.Character.ReachTriggerBreachNote: First use of each Reach Trigger per Adventure is free; each additional use applies 1 Influence Breach (Temp Influence first, then Core Influence, same as Apply Influence Injury).
ESSENCE.Character.OriginFeatureTooltip: From this character's Species/Heritage/Distinction — edit it on that Item, not here.
ESSENCE.Character.ExceedsReachCharacter: Reach cost exceeds this character's current Reach. Non-blocking.
ESSENCE.Chat.OpenRollNoteSingular: {surges} candidate die at 6+ (excluding the Success Die) — Defense wasn't declared, so the GM decides how many actually count.
ESSENCE.Chat.OpenRollNotePlural: {surges} candidate dice at 6+ (excluding the Success Die) — Defense wasn't declared, so the GM decides how many actually count.
ESSENCE.Item.Augment.CompatibilityPlaceh: e.g. Any, Weapon, Requires Tier 3+ Chassis
ESSENCE.Item.Augment.FunctionHint: A Function Augment grants an Equipment Action/Reaction with limited Uses that refresh at the end of the Adventure unless stated otherwise.
ESSENCE.Item.Augment.SupportHint: A Support Augment is an always-active modifier with no Uses. Installed normally it modifies its Chassis directly; if its Mount is Linked and the Link is On, it modifies the paired Function instead.
ESSENCE.Item.Equipment.AlwaysModularHint: Always assembled from a Chassis + Fitting (+ Augments) below — Fortitude/Resilience/Movement come from those pieces, not this item.
ESSENCE.Item.Equipment.UsesRefreshHint: (each card's Uses refresh at end of Adventure)
ESSENCE.Item.Equipment.AssignFreeHint: Assigning a {chassisLabel}/{fittingLabel} above is free. Use the buttons below only when the change happens formally during an Adventure and should spend its Action Dice cost.
ESSENCE.Item.Equipment.TemplateAssignHin: Assigning a {chassisLabel}/{fittingLabel}/Augments above is free while authoring a compendium template — reconfiguration dice costs only apply once a character actually owns this item.
ESSENCE.Item.Equipment.ReachExceptionHin: Leave blank — this is normally set automatically by the Item Grants system (Quartermaster's Due, Internal Compartment) when a player uses "Choose Item" on their character sheet. Only fill this in by hand for a one-off manual exception.
ESSENCE.Item.Species.SubChoiceLegend: Nested sub-choice (optional — e.g. "choose two Senses" buried in this trait's own text)
ESSENCE.Item.Species.NatureOptionsPlaceh: e.g. Low-Light Vision, Keen Hearing, Keen Scent
ESSENCE.Item.Monster.TacticsHint: Ordered — follow the first instruction that applies rather than optimizing this Mook's turn.
ESSENCE.Item.Monster.LeaderAbilitiesHint: Encounter-scale abilities this Leader uses to manipulate its allies — target priorities, Tactics overrides, formations, extra activations.
ESSENCE.Item.Monster.SoloAbilitiesHint: Encounter-scale action-economy tools that let this one Elite occupy the tactical space of several combatants — extra activation windows, reactions, phases, wound-triggered changes.
ESSENCE.Item.Monster.AbilitiesHint: Plain-text Abilities replace Combat Cards for this Grade — tag each with how often it's usable.
ESSENCE.Wizard.BulkImport.Title: Bulk Import
ESSENCE.Wizard.BulkImport.NoPermission: You don't have permission to create content. Ask your GM to grant Foundry's "Create Items" permission (Configure Settings > Configure Permissions).
ESSENCE.Wizard.BulkImport.Intro: Download a CSV template, fill it out (Excel, Google Sheets, or any spreadsheet app that exports CSV), then upload it here. Matching by name: a row whose name already exists in the compendium updates that item in place; a new name creates a new one.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Content.NoPermission: You don't have permission to create content. Ask your GM to grant Foundry's "Create Items" permission (Configure Settings > Configure Permissions), or have them create it for you.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Content.Title: Create Content
ESSENCE.Wizard.Content.Intro: Choose what you're creating and give it a name. It's saved straight into the shared compendium.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Content.BodyHint: The card's printed effect, one labeled paragraph per row (e.g. Target, Effect, Range).
ESSENCE.Wizard.Content.EquipmentCardsHin: One row per granted Equipment Card — each has its own Uses, refreshing at end of Adventure.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Content.ConditionSections: One row per labeled section (e.g. EFFECT, DURATION, REMOVAL) — matches how existing Conditions read on the sheet.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Content.ChassisMountsHint: Every Chassis has at least 1 Mount (§ Augment Mounts). Set "Linked with" to another Mount's number to pair them as a Linked Mount, or leave blank for an independent Mount.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Content.CreatedInCompendi: {name} has been created in the {label} compendium.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Monster.ConceptHint: Grade sets the stat budget every later step uses — pick it first. Tier is raw power, Grade is GM-facing complexity/weight, Role is its battlefield job. There's no canonical formula for Grade in the rules yet, so these are tunable defaults: Mook (runs in numbers, scripted by Tactics below), Normal (a real individual fight, GM-controlled), Elite (rare, uses the full combat engine — set Elite Type once you know if it's a Champion, Leader, or Solo).
ESSENCE.Wizard.Monster.DomainEmphasisHin: Auto-Generate leans the point-buy toward this domain's Attributes and Styles — it doesn't exclude the other two.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Monster.AutoGenerateHint: Fills Attributes, Combat Styles, Resilience, Temporary Wounds, Combat Cards, and Equipment from the budget above. Safe to run again — it overwrites, doesn't add.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Monster.OriginHint: Optional — a Species or Distinction can grant passive features and unlock a gated Combat Style.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Monster.MonsterOriginHint: Monster Type is flavor, not a hard rule — pick whichever fits. Distinction is still optional, and still the only way to unlock a gated Combat Style.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Monster.EliteMonsterTypes: Elite-only Monster Types (Tier 3-5, rare and world-scale):
ESSENCE.Wizard.Monster.GatedSkillsHint: Gestalt, Magecraft, Psionics, Ritualism, and Calling are gated — a matching Distinction is required to put points in them.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Monster.AttributesHint: Distribute {pool} points across the 9 Attributes, starting at 1 each, none above {max}.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Monster.SkillsHint: Distribute {pool} points among the 9 Combat Styles, none above Rank {max}.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Monster.WoundsHint: Order never changes: Damage → Resilience → Wounds → Temporary Wounds → Core Wounds. Auto-Generate sets these from the Grade budget; adjust freely.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Monster.FinalizeHint: No hard requirements to check here — an NPC is playable at any point. Close this wizard and open the NPC sheet whenever it's ready.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Character.ConceptHint: Decide who the character is before touching any numbers. Confirm the campaign's starting Tier with your GM.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Character.IdentityHint: Choose a Species, Heritage, and Distinction. Base Action Pool = 5 + Tier = {pool}.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Character.GatedSkillsHint: Gestalt, Magecraft, Psionics, Ritualism, and Calling are gated — you can't invest Style Points in them without the matching Distinction.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Character.AttributesHint: Distribute {pool} points across the 9 Attributes, starting at 1 each, none above 3.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Character.WoundsHint: Order never changes: Damage → Resilience → Wounds → Temporary Wounds → Core Wounds. Most characters start at 0 Resilience and 0 Temporary Wounds — gear and features grant more.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Character.SkillsHint: Distribute {pool} points among the 9 Combat Styles — no Style above Rank 2 at creation.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Character.ExpertisesHint: Each Expertise must belong to a Style rated at least 1. No per-Style limit — specialize or spread out.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Character.AssignRankHint: Assign at least 1 Rank to a Combat Style above to unlock its Expertises.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Character.InfluenceHint: Influence folds wealth, reputation, and pull into one resource. Reach is its scale.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Character.CoreInfluenceHi: (never spent by choice — new characters begin unmarked)
ESSENCE.Wizard.Character.NonCombatSkills: Non-Combat Skills — {spent} / {pool} points, max 2 each. Remaining: {remaining}
ESSENCE.Wizard.Character.IntellectSkills: Skills from Intellect — {have} / {count} granted, free at Rank 1. Choose these before spending the points below.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Character.PassiveFeatures: Species/Heritage/Distinction traits are collected automatically. Add anything else standing here (Skill Tree passives, campaign bonuses, etc.).
ESSENCE.Wizard.Character.EquipmentHint: Your Inventory Loadout is what you bring on this Adventure, up to your Inventory Equipment Limit. The Armory fills in as you play.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Character.ExceedsReachYou: Reach cost exceeds your current Reach. Non-blocking.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Character.FinalizeHint: Confirm final Resources, Defenses, and Base Action Pool, then check every requirement.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Character.WeaknessesNote: Weaknesses are intentional. Once your GM approves the sheet, you're ready to play.
ESSENCE.Settings.GradeBudgets.Title: Monster Grade Budgets
ESSENCE.Settings.GradeBudgets.Hint: Tune the homebrew stat budgets the Monster Creator uses to auto-fill a Grade (Mook/Normal/Elite).

ESSENCE.Notify.SecondReactionWarning: {name} already used a Reaction during this Turn. V6 only allows one response per chain — if this is responding to a genuinely different chain, this is fine to ignore.

ESSENCE.Notify.NothingToRecover: {name} had nothing to recover — resources are already full and no Core Wounds were selected.

ESSENCE.Notify.NoQualifyingItemNpc: No item in this NPC's Inventory currently qualifies for {source}.

ESSENCE.Notify.IntellectSkillsAlreadyGra: Already granted {count} Skill(s) from Intellect — remove one first.
